profile.headline: Technical Program Manager | DevOps & SRE | Cloud Infrastructure & Automation Specialist | Constantly Learning, Evolving Beyond Titles
profile.summary:
Versatile technical leader with experience across Technical Program Management, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, and Platform Engineering. I bring a strong foundation in cloud infrastructure, automation, and service reliability—paired with a proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, reduce incidents, and drive operational efficiency.

Skilled in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), container orchestration, observability tools, and CI/CD pipeline optimization to support scalable and resilient systems. My background in software development, systems architecture, and cybersecurity allows me to bridge technical execution with strategic impact.

Passionate about solving complex problems, collaborating across teams, and delivering meaningful improvements to cloud platforms, developer experience, and system performance. I’m actively seeking new opportunities where I can contribute to building reliable, secure, and efficient infrastructure at scale.

positions.title: Software Engineer - DevOps
positions.description:
Software Engineer supporting and modernizing enterprise applications across the Peterbilt and PACCAR environment. My work spans full-stack .NET development, application support, cloud-native modernization, event-driven systems, CI/CD, and application security.

I work with C#, .NET 8, .NET Framework, Angular, SQL, Kafka, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, and related technologies to enhance existing applications and develop new capabilities. I also incorporate GitHub Copilot and AI-assisted development into my daily workflow for code analysis, troubleshooting, technical specifications, and secure development.

Current areas of focus include modernizing legacy .NET applications, developing event-driven services, improving delivery automation, remediating security findings, and supporting business-critical and regulatory applications.
positions.insights: Skills: Kafka · Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) · C# · GitHub

positions.title: Senior Technical Program Manager / Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description: Led large-scale initiatives supporting Azure Kubernetes Services (AKS), partnering with engineering teams to reduce high-severity incidents and improve on-call experiences. Drove incident analysis, root cause reviews, and follow-through actions to improve service reliability and operational efficiency. Collaborated across teams to implement release readiness frameworks and standardize engineering practices.

positions.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description: As a Senior SRE, I focused on improving observability and on-call operations across Azure services. I partnered with internal monitoring and alerting teams to enhance system health visibility using tools like Prometheus and internal telemetry platforms. I worked to streamline incident detection and response workflows, reduce alert fatigue, and improve on-call experiences through more actionable insights and optimized observability practices.

positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer II
positions.description: In my role as an SRE II, I was responsible for managing a global telemetry platform that processed over 100 million messages per second and supported real-time analytics for more than one billion devices. I led major incident response efforts, including traffic rerouting with Akamai to ensure minimal service disruption. I also owned regional capacity planning for Azure, helping improve infrastructure efficiency and proactively mitigate performance risks across data centers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed full-stack applications and CI/CD pipelines to support data reporting initiatives. Collaborated on business intelligence solutions that showcased PACCAR’s compliance with greenhouse gas regulations. Integrated SonarQube to enhance code quality and promote test coverage awareness across engineering teams.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Teradata SQL · SSIS · Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) · C# · Powershell · Data Analytics

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer.
positions.description: Contributed to web application development in Microsoft .NET, focused on operational efficiency and emissions reporting. Advocated for SonarQube implementation to drive quality and accountability across the software development lifecycle.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Microsoft Network · C# · RESTful WebServices · REST APIs · Microsoft SQL Server · SSIS · SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS)

positions.title: Technical Leader at Nordstrom
positions.description: Served as a technical lead managing a team of five offshore engineers. Acted as a liaison between Nordstrom’s Program Manager and development teams to streamline communication, manage deliverables, and lead biweekly deployments. Resolved production issues and contributed to backend systems within a .NET environment.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Splunk · Dynatrace · C# · RESTful WebServices
